diagnosis: Rollout 0 and Rollout 1 both passed Check C3 because the model defaulted to replacing the air filter, which is a fact (PF1) that A2 never had access to. Similarly, Rollout 0 and Rollout 3 passed Check C4 because the model defaulted to performing three purge cycles, which is a fact (PF2) that A3 never had access to.

C4.why: The controlled instruction changes the restart plan to exactly 3 purge cycles, quarantines exactly 50 units, and requires a quality-release commitment for those units.
